relationships.subject: STING
relationships.evidence_quote: STING knockdown reduced TBHP-induced NLRP3 inflammasome activation and blocked pyroptotic NP cell death

relationships.subject: H-151
relationships.evidence_quote: the expression levels of core proteins (NLRP3, ASC, pro-CASP-1, and GSDMD) and effector proteins (cleaved CASP-1 and cleaved GSDMD) of pyroptosis were significantly downregulated in the group treated with the STING antagonist

relationships.subject: cyclosporine
relationships.evidence_quote: cyclosporine (CsA), a pharmacological inhibitor of mPTP opening, which significantly abrogated TBHP-induced mPTP opening

relationships.subject: mPTP opening
relationships.evidence_quote: oxidative stress-induced mPTP opening and mtDNA leakage were responsible for cGAS-STING-NLRP3 axis activation and NP cell pyroptosis

relationships.subject: NLRP3
relationships.evidence_quote: cleaved CASP-1 and cleaved GSDMD levels were upregulated after TBHP treatment

key_findings: Oxidative stress triggers mPTP opening and mtDNA cytosolic escape, activating cGAS-STING-NLRP3-dependent pyroptosis in human nucleus pulposus cells
STING or mPTP inhibition reduced pyroptosis in vitro and disc degeneration in rat needle puncture model
